advisorModel: Sets the model that answers when Claude calls the advisor tool, and turns the advisor off when unset.
agent: Starts the main thread as the named subagent, with the system prompt, tool limits, and model of that subagent.
agentPushNotifEnabled: Lets Claude send a push notification to your phone when Claude decides that a notification is useful.
allowAllClaudeAiMcps: Loads the claude.ai connectors that Claude Code gets itself together with a deployed managed-mcp.json file.
allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp: Lets the built-in Claude in Chrome server run together with a deployed managed-mcp.json file.
allowedChannelPlugins: Replaces the default Anthropic allowlist of channel plugins that can push messages into sessions.
allowedHttpHookUrls: Limits HTTP hooks to URLs that match these patterns and blocks all other HTTP hooks.
allowedMcpServers: Limits the MCP servers that people can add to the servers that match this allowlist.
allowedProviders: Limits the API providers that this machine can use and refuses sessions on other providers.
allowManagedHooksOnly: Runs only managed hooks, Agent SDK hooks, and hooks from force-enabled plugins, and blocks all other hooks.
allowManagedMcpServersOnly: Uses only the allowedMcpServers list from managed settings and ignores allowlists in user, project, and local settings.
allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly: Uses only permission rules from managed settings and ignores allow, ask, and deny rules from all other sources.
alwaysThinkingEnabled: Turns extended thinking off for all sessions when set to false, because thinking is on by default.
apiKeyHelper: Runs your shell command to make the credential that Claude Code sends with model requests.
askUserQuestionTimeout: Sets the idle time after which an unanswered question continues automatically with the options that you selected.
appendPlugins: Runs the mods of these managed plugins after all mods that a user installs, in the listed order.
attribution: Sets the attribution text that Claude Code adds to git commits and pull requests, or removes all of it.
attribution.commit: Sets the attribution text that Claude Code adds to git commits, and an empty string removes it.
attribution.pr: Sets the attribution text that Claude Code adds to pull request descriptions, and an empty string removes it.
attribution.sessionUrl: Removes the claude.ai session link from commits and pull requests in cloud and Remote Control sessions when false.
autoCompactEnabled: Turns automatic compaction of the conversation on or off when the context gets near its limit.
autoCompactWindow: Sets the number of tokens in the context window at which Claude Code compacts the conversation automatically.
autoConnectIde: Connects Claude Code automatically to a running VS Code or JetBrains IDE when you start it from an external terminal.
autoContinueAtUsageLimit: Keeps the session open after a claude.ai usage limit stops it and continues the task automatically after the reset.
autoInstallIdeExtension: Installs the Claude Code IDE extension automatically when you start Claude Code from a VS Code terminal.
autoMemoryDirectory: Sets the directory where Claude Code keeps auto memory, in place of the default directory for each project.
autoMemoryEnabled: Turns auto memory on or off, and when false, Claude does not read or write the auto memory directory.
autoMode: Adds your own allow and deny rules to the auto mode classifier, such as trusted repositories and domains.
autoMode.classifyAllShell: Sends every shell command to the auto mode classifier in auto mode, also commands that a narrow allow rule matches.
autoScrollEnabled: Follows new output to the bottom of the conversation in the fullscreen renderer, or keeps your scroll position when false.
autoUpdatesChannel: Sets the release channel for auto-updates, either the latest release or a stable version that is about one week old.
availableModels: Limits the models that people can select for the main session, subagents, skills, and the advisor.
availableModelsMatch: Sets how availableModels entries match model IDs, so that with exact, an entry permits only the version it names.
awaySummaryEnabled: Shows a one-line session recap when you come back to the terminal, or stops the recap when false.
awsAuthRefresh: Runs your command to refresh the credentials in your .aws directory when the Amazon Bedrock credentials stop working.
awsCredentialExport: Runs your command that prints AWS credentials as JSON, which Claude Code then uses for Amazon Bedrock requests.
axScreenReader: Shows flat text without decorative borders or animations, for use with a screen reader.
bashEditDiffEnabled: Records the Git repository files that change while a Bash command runs and shows their diff, in all permission modes.
bashOutputMaxChars: Sets the maximum number of characters of successful shell command output that Claude receives inline.
blockedMarketplaces: Blocks the listed plugin marketplace sources for your organization before any download occurs.
browserExternalPageTools: Stops Claude from using its tools on external pages in the desktop Browser pane, but people can still open them.
channelsEnabled: Allows channels for your organization, which Team and Enterprise plans block until you set this key to true.
claudeInChromeDefaultEnabled: Turns on Chrome integration when each session starts in the interactive CLI and the VS Code extension.
claudeMd: Adds organization-wide CLAUDE.md instructions from managed settings, which load before user and project CLAUDE.md files.
claudeMdExcludes: Stops Claude Code from loading the CLAUDE.md files that match these patterns or paths.
cleanupPeriodDays: Sets the number of days that Claude Code keeps session transcripts before it deletes them.
companyAnnouncements: Shows your organization's announcements at startup, with one announcement chosen at random for each session.
copyFullResponse: Makes /copy copy the full response each time without the picker.
copyOnSelect: Copies text to your clipboard when you select it with the mouse in the fullscreen renderer and agent view.
crossSessionInbound: Sets whether this session accepts, holds, or refuses messages from your other Claude Code sessions.
defaultShell: Sets whether Bash or PowerShell runs the shell commands that you type with the ! prefix.
defaultToAgentsView: Opens agent view instead of a new conversation when you run claude with no arguments.
deniedMcpServers: Blocks the MCP servers that match a name, command, or URL, even if an allowlist permits them.
deniedModels: Blocks the listed models everywhere, even models that availableModels permits.
desktopSessionCleanupPeriodDays: Sets the maximum age in days for Claude Desktop and Cowork session transcripts before Claude Code deletes them.
dialogExpiry: Sets how long Claude Code waits for an answer to a forwarded dialog before it cancels the dialog.
diffTool: Sets whether proposed file changes open in the VS Code or JetBrains diff viewer or stay in the terminal.
disableAgentView: Turns off background agents and agent view, including claude agents, --bg, and /background.
disableAllHooks: Turns off hooks, the custom status line, and the custom file suggestion command, without removing them from settings.
disableArtifact: Turns the Artifact tool off when set to true, but this key is deprecated and enableArtifact replaces it.
disableAutoMode: Removes auto mode from the permission mode cycle, and sessions that start in auto mode start in default mode.
disableBrowserExternalNavigation: Limits the desktop Browser pane to localhost pages for people and Claude.
disableBundledSkills: Removes the skills and workflows that come with Claude Code and hides built-in commands from Claude.
disableClaudeAiConnectors: Stops Claude Code from getting and connecting the claude.ai MCP connectors.
disableCommandPluginSources: Blocks plugins that install through a command from the marketplace, and stops loading plugins of that type already installed.
disableDeepLinkRegistration: Stops Claude Code from registering the claude-cli:// protocol handler with the operating system.
disableDesktopLocalSessions: Turns off Desktop Code sessions on the device, but SSH sessions to other hosts and cloud sessions continue to work.
disabledMcpjsonServers: Rejects the listed servers from a project .mcp.json file, so Claude Code does not connect them or ask about them.
disableMobileSimulatorTools: Blocks Claude's tools in the desktop iOS Simulator pane, but people can still use the pane.
disableRemoteControl: Turns off Remote Control everywhere, including the command, the flag, the automatic start, and the toggle in the session.
disableSideloadFlags: Rejects the --plugin-dir, --plugin-url, --agents, and --mcp-config flags at startup and stops with an error.
disableSkillShellExecution: Stops inline shell commands in skills and custom commands from running and shows a disabled message in their place.
disableWorkflows: Turns off dynamic workflows and the bundled workflow commands for all people that your settings reach.
editorMode: Sets the key binding mode of the input prompt to normal or vim.
effortLevel: Sets the default effort level for models that do not have a saved effort level of their own.
emojiCompletionEnabled: Shows emoji suggestions after a colon in the prompt input and replaces a complete shortcode with its emoji.
enableAllProjectMcpServers: Approves all MCP servers in project .mcp.json files without a prompt.
enableArtifact: Turns the Artifact tool off when false in any file, and no other file can turn it back on.
enabledMcpjsonServers: Approves the listed servers from a project .mcp.json file, so Claude Code connects them without a prompt.
enabledPlugins: Turns each plugin on or off, keyed by plugin name and marketplace name.
enableWorkflows: Turns dynamic workflows on or off for you when the default of your plan is not what you want.
enforceAvailableModels: Changes the /model Default choice to the first availableModels entry when the default model is outside that list.
env: Sets environment variables for each session and for the subprocesses that Claude Code starts.
externalEditorContext: Shows the last response from Claude as comment lines in the external editor that Ctrl+G opens.
extraKnownMarketplaces: Adds plugin marketplaces by name for people who open the repository or for all people that managed settings reach.
fallbackModel: Sets the backup models, in order, that Claude Code tries when the primary model is overloaded or not available.
fastMode: Turns fast mode on for sessions where fast mode is available, for more speed at a higher cost per token.
fastModePerSessionOptIn: Stops a saved fastMode setting from turning on fast mode at session start, so people run /fast in each session.
feedbackDrafts: Sets whether Claude can queue feedback drafts for your review and whether Claude Code shows a card for each draft.
feedbackSurveyRate: Sets the probability, from 0 to 1, that the session quality survey appears, and 0 stops the survey.
fileCheckpointingEnabled: Keeps snapshots of files before each edit so that /rewind can restore them, or stops the snapshots when false.
fileSuggestion: Runs your command to supply the @ file path suggestions in place of the built-in file suggestion.
footerLinksRegexes: Shows clickable link badges below the input box when a regex matches IDs in the output, such as issue keys.
forceLoginGatewayUrl: Sets the cloud gateway URL that the /login screen connects to, so people do not type the address.
forceLoginMethod: Limits login to claude.ai accounts, Claude Console accounts, or a cloud gateway.
forceLoginOrgUUID: Limits claude.ai logins to one or more Anthropic organizations, but only a managed source enforces this limit.
forceRemoteSettingsRefresh: Stops startup until Claude Code gets fresh server-managed settings, and exits if it cannot get them.
gatewayInternalNetworks: Sets the public IPv4 blocks of your internal network, so /login accepts a cloud gateway on those addresses.
gcpAuthRefresh: Runs your command to refresh Google Cloud credentials when they expire or do not load.
hooks: Runs your commands, prompts, agents, HTTP requests, or MCP tools at specified points in the Claude Code lifecycle.
httpHookAllowedEnvVars: Limits the environment variables that HTTP hooks can put in request headers to the variables in this list.
includeCoAuthoredBy: Removes the commit trailer and pull request attribution when false, but this key is deprecated and attribution replaces it.
includeGitInstructions: Removes the built-in commit and pull request instructions and the git status snapshot from the context of Claude when false.
inputNeededNotifEnabled: Sends a push notification to your phone when a permission prompt or question waits for your input.
isolatePeerMachines: Asks for your approval before Claude sends a message to one of your sessions on a different machine.
keybindingFlavor: Has no effect because the word-editing shortcuts always use readline conventions.
language: Sets the language that Claude uses for responses, voice dictation, and session titles.
leftArrowOpensAgents: Lets the left arrow key on an empty prompt move the session to the background and open agent view.
managedMcpServers: Adds remote MCP servers for all users, which users cannot edit or remove, together with the servers they add.
managedSourcesBehavior: Combines the keys from all managed sources when set to merge, instead of using only the highest-priority source.
maxEffortLevel: Sets the maximum effort level for all models or for each model, on all providers.
maxProseWidth: Sets the maximum column width of prose in responses from Claude, but tables and code blocks keep the full width.
minimumVersion: Stops auto-updates and claude update from installing a version below this version.
model: Sets the model that each new session starts with.
modelOverrides: Maps Anthropic model IDs to model IDs of your provider, such as Amazon Bedrock inference profile ARNs.
modelPicker: Sets the models that the /model picker shows, with your own order and labels.
modelPricing: Shows costs at the contracted rates of your organization instead of list prices.
modelSettings: Keeps a saved effort level, effort cap, or auto-compact window for each model.
otelHeadersHelper: Runs your command to make the headers that Claude Code sends with OpenTelemetry exports, for tokens that rotate.
outputStyle: Sets the output style, which changes the role, tone, and output format of Claude.
parentSettingsBehavior: Sets whether Claude Code applies or ignores restrictions from an SDK or IDE host when you deploy managed settings.
permissionExplainerEnabled: Has no effect. Claude Code removed this key in v2.1.257.
permissions: Sets the allow, ask, and deny rules for tools and the permission mode that sessions start in.
permissions.additionalDirectories: Gives Claude file access to more directories outside the directory where you started.
permissions.allow: Approves the listed tool uses without a permission prompt.
permissions.ask: Shows a permission prompt before the listed tool uses, even in modes that approve them automatically.
permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDire: Stops the file tools from reading files outside the working directories in all permission modes.
permissions.defaultMode: Sets the permission mode that new sessions start in.
permissions.deny: Blocks the listed tool uses, such as reads of files that contain secrets.
permissions.disableBypassPermissionsMode: Stops all users from entering bypassPermissions mode and rejects the --dangerously-skip-permissions flag.
plansDirectory: Sets the directory, relative to the project root, where plan mode writes plan files.
pluginConfigs: Keeps the non-sensitive answers that you gave in the configuration dialog of a plugin.
pluginSuggestionMarketplaces: Sets the marketplaces whose plugins can show as install suggestions in spinner tips and in /plugin.
pluginTrustMessage: Adds your organization's text to the warning that Claude Code shows before a plugin installs.
policyHelper: Runs an executable that you deploy to calculate managed settings at startup.
policyHelper.path: Sets the absolute path of the helper executable that Claude Code runs.
policyHelper.refreshIntervalMs: Sets the interval in milliseconds at which Claude Code runs the helper again in the background.
policyHelper.timeoutMs: Sets the time in milliseconds that Claude Code waits for the helper before the run fails.
preferredNotifChannel: Sets whether Claude Code uses a terminal bell or a desktop notification when a task completes or a prompt waits.
prefersReducedMotion: Decreases or stops the spinner, shimmer, and flash animations in the interface.
prependPlugins: Runs the mods of these managed plugins before all mods that a user installs, in the listed order.
processWrapper: Starts the background processes of Claude Code through a corporate launcher command on macOS and Linux.
promptCacheTtl: Sets the prompt cache duration for the main conversation to five minutes or one hour.
promptSuggestionEnabled: Shows the gray predicted prompts in the input box, or hides them when false.
prStatusFooterEnabled: Shows the pull request status badge in the prompt footer, or stops the badge and its check when false.
prUrlTemplate: Changes the pull request links that Claude Code shows to point at an internal code review tool instead of github.com.
remote.defaultEnvironmentId: Sets the default cloud environment for claude --cloud, and reads self-hosted ccpool_ IDs only from user, managed, and --settings sources.
remoteControlAtStartup: Connects Remote Control automatically when each interactive session starts.
requiredMaximumVersion: Stops Claude Code from starting if its version is newer than the maximum version that your organization permits.
requiredMinimumVersion: Stops Claude Code from starting if its version is older than the minimum version that your organization requires.
respectGitignore: Removes files that match .gitignore patterns from the @ file picker.
respondToBashCommands: Adds the output of ! shell commands to the context without a reply from Claude when set to false.
sandbox: Isolates Bash commands from your filesystem and network on macOS, Linux, and WSL2.
sandbox.allowAppleEvents: Lets sandboxed commands on macOS send Apple Events, which removes isolation for code execution.
sandbox.allowUnsandboxedCommands: Lets Claude run a blocked command again outside the sandbox when true, or stops this when false.
sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed: Runs sandboxed Bash commands without a permission prompt, but deny rules and specific ask rules still apply.
sandbox.bwrapPath: Sets the absolute path of a bubblewrap binary that is not on PATH, on Linux and WSL2.
sandbox.credentials: Hides or masks the credential files and environment variables that you list from sandboxed commands.
sandbox.credentials.allowPlaintextInject: Lets the sandbox proxy put masked credentials into plain HTTP requests, for trusted test networks only.
sandbox.credentials.awsPairs: Links masked AWS key variables with custom names into one credential for SigV4 re-signing.
sandbox.credentials.envVars: Removes or masks the listed environment variables for sandboxed commands.
sandbox.credentials.files: Blocks or masks reads of the listed credential files and directories by sandboxed commands.
sandbox.credentials.sigv4: Sets whether streaming, presigned, and SigV4A AWS requests with masked credentials fail or pass through the sandbox proxy.
sandbox.enabled: Turns on the sandbox for Bash commands on macOS, Linux, and WSL2.
sandbox.enableWeakerNestedSandbox: Lets the Linux sandbox run in an unprivileged container with less isolation of process information.
sandbox.enableWeakerNetworkIsolation: Lets sandboxed tools on macOS reach the system TLS trust service to verify certificates behind a MITM proxy.
sandbox.excludedCommands: Sets the commands that Claude Code runs outside the sandbox.
sandbox.failIfUnavailable: Stops Claude Code at startup with an error when the sandbox is on but cannot start.
sandbox.filesystem: Sets the paths that sandboxed commands can read and write.
sandbox.filesystem.allowManagedReadPaths: Uses only allowRead entries from managed settings, so developers cannot open read access to blocked paths again.
sandbox.filesystem.allowRead: Permits reads of specific paths inside an area that denyRead blocks.
sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite: Adds paths where sandboxed commands can write, in addition to the working directory and temp directory.
sandbox.filesystem.denyRead: Stops sandboxed commands from reading the listed paths.
sandbox.filesystem.denyWrite: Stops sandboxed commands from writing to the listed paths, also inside directories that are otherwise writable.
sandbox.filesystem.disabled: Turns off filesystem isolation for sandboxed commands but keeps network isolation on.
sandbox.ignoreViolations: Stops violation reports for expected access attempts by a command, but the sandbox still blocks the access.
sandbox.network: Sets the hosts, ports, and sockets that sandboxed commands can connect to.
sandbox.network.allowAllUnixSockets: Lets sandboxed commands connect to all Unix sockets.
sandbox.network.allowedDomains: Permits the listed domains for sandboxed commands, so the sandbox does not prompt for them.
sandbox.network.allowLocalBinding: Lets sandboxed commands on macOS listen on network ports and connect to any port on localhost.
sandbox.network.allowMachLookup: Lets sandboxed tools on macOS, such as the iOS Simulator or Playwright, look up the listed XPC services.
sandbox.network.allowManagedDomainsOnly: Uses only the domain allowlist from managed settings and blocks other domains without a prompt.
sandbox.network.allowUnixSockets: Sets the Unix socket paths that sandboxed commands can use on macOS.
sandbox.network.deniedDomains: Blocks the listed domains for sandboxed commands, also when an allowed wildcard matches them.
sandbox.network.httpProxyPort: Sends sandbox HTTP traffic through your own proxy on this local port, which then does the filtering.
sandbox.network.socksProxyPort: Sends sandbox SOCKS traffic through your own proxy on this local port, which then does the filtering.
sandbox.network.strictAllowlist: Blocks sandboxed commands from hosts that are not on the allowlist, instead of a prompt.
sandbox.network.tlsTerminate: Makes the sandbox proxy terminate TLS so that it can read the contents of HTTPS requests.
sandbox.ripgrep: Sets your own ripgrep binary for use in the sandbox.
sandbox.socatPath: Sets the absolute path of a socat binary that is not on PATH, for the sandbox proxy.
showClearContextOnPlanAccept: Adds an option to the plan approval menu that approves the plan and clears the conversation context.
showThinkingSummaries: Shows full summaries of the extended thinking of Claude instead of a collapsed stub.
showTurnDuration: Shows the turn duration message after each response, or hides it when false.
skillListingBudgetFraction: Sets the fraction of the context window that the skill listing can use each turn.
skillListingMaxDescChars: Sets the maximum number of characters of description text for each skill in the skill listing.
skillOverrides: Hides a skill or shows only its name, without changes to its SKILL.md file.
skipAutoPermissionPrompt: Skips the one-time notice that Claude Code shows when you first enter auto mode yourself.
skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt: Skips the confirmation dialog before a session enters bypassPermissions mode.
skipWebFetchPreflight: Skips the WebFetch check that sends each hostname to Anthropic, for environments that block traffic to Anthropic.
spellcheck: Underlines misspelled words in the prompt input with a spell checker that you install.
spinnerTipsEnabled: Shows tips in the spinner while Claude works, or hides them when false.
spinnerTipsOverride: Adds your own tips to the spinner tips, or replaces the built-in tips with your tips.
spinnerVerbs: Adds verbs to the spinner verbs that show while a turn runs, or replaces the built-in verbs.
sshConfigs: Adds SSH connections to the environment list in Claude Desktop.
sshHostAllowlist: Limits the hosts that Desktop SSH sessions can connect to.
statusLine: Runs your command to show a status line below the prompt.
strictKnownMarketplaces: Limits the plugin marketplace sources that users can add and install plugins from to this allowlist.
strictPluginOnlyCustomization: Blocks skills, agents, hooks, and MCP servers from user and project sources, and permits only plugins and managed settings.
strictPluginOnlyCustomization.agents: Loads agents only from plugins, built-in agents, and managed sources, and blocks user and project agents.
strictPluginOnlyCustomization.hooks: Runs hooks only from plugins and managed settings, and blocks hooks from user, project, and local settings.
strictPluginOnlyCustomization.mcp: Loads MCP servers only from plugins and managed sources, and blocks servers from .claude.json and .mcp.json.
strictPluginOnlyCustomization.skills: Loads skills only from plugins, bundled skills, and managed sources, and blocks user, project, and synced skills.
subagentPromptCacheTtl: Sets the prompt cache duration for subagents and other requests outside the main conversation to five minutes or one hour.
subagentStatusLine: Runs your command to change the rows in the subagent task display.
switchModelsOnFlag: Sets whether Claude Code uses the fallback model or pauses for your decision when a safety classifier flags a request.
syncClaudeAiPlugins: Stops the download and load of plugins from your claude.ai account when set to false.
syncClaudeAiSkills: Stops the download and load of skills from your claude.ai account when set to false.
syntaxHighlightingDisabled: Turns off syntax highlighting in diffs, code blocks, and file previews when set to true.
taskOutputMaxChars: Has no effect. Claude Code removed this key in v2.1.277.
teammateDefaultModel: Has no effect. Claude Code removed this key in v2.1.234.
teammateMode: Sets where agent team teammates show, in the main terminal pane or in split panes.
terminalProgressBarEnabled: Shows a progress indicator in terminals that support it while Claude works, or hides it when false.
terminalTitleFromRename: Lets /rename and --name change the terminal tab title, or keeps the generated title when false.
theme: Sets the color theme of the interface, either a built-in theme or a custom theme.
timeFormat: Sets the format of the times in the interface: 12-hour, 24-hour, UTC, or a strftime pattern.
timeZone: Sets the time zone for the times in the interface, in place of your system time zone.
tui: Sets the terminal renderer to the fullscreen renderer or the classic renderer.
ultracode: Starts sessions with ultracode on, so Claude plans a workflow for each nontrivial task without a request.
useAutoModeDuringPlan: Lets the auto mode classifier review shell commands in plan mode, or shows a prompt for each command when false.
verbose: Shows the full tool output instead of short summaries, but viewMode has priority when both are set.
viewMode: Sets the transcript view that each session starts in: default, verbose, or focus.
vimInsertModeRemaps: Maps a two-key sequence in vim INSERT mode, such as jj, to Escape.
voice: Turns on voice dictation and sets the dictation key to hold mode or tap mode.
voiceEnabled: Turns on voice dictation with the older Boolean form, but this key is deprecated and voice.enabled replaces it.
wheelScrollAccelerationEnabled: Increases the mouse-wheel scroll speed during fast scrolls in the fullscreen renderer, or keeps a constant speed when false.
workflowKeywordTriggerEnabled: Starts a dynamic workflow when you type the word ultracode in a prompt, or stops this when false.
workflowSizeGuideline: Sets the number of agents that Claude aims for in dynamic workflows, as advice and not as a hard limit.
worktree: Sets how Claude Code makes and manages git worktrees.
worktree.baseRef: Sets whether new worktrees branch from the remote default branch or from your local HEAD.
worktree.bgIsolation: Lets background sessions edit the working copy directly without a worktree when set to none.
worktree.location: Sets the folder on a remote machine where Desktop SSH sessions make their worktrees.
worktree.sparsePaths: Checks out only the listed directories and root-level files in each worktree, with git sparse-checkout.
worktree.symlinkDirectories: Adds symlinks in each worktree to the listed directories of the main repository, so large directories are not copied.
wslInheritsWindowsSettings: Makes Claude Code on WSL read managed settings from the Windows policy chain.
